ordered_diagnoses: Transient Ischemic Attack of the Vertebrobasilar System

facts.raw_span: a 20-day history of episodic slurred speech
episodes lasted about 10 minutes without loss of consciousness, headache, dizziness, diplopia, dysphagia, or limb weakness
by presentation, they occurred 2–3 times daily lasting about 30 minutes
hypertension (>20 years), diabetes mellitus (8 years), and coronary heart disease (8 years)
he was blind bilaterally after retinal detachment in adolescence
temperature was 36.5°C
heart rate 70/min, respiratory rate 17/min, and blood pressure 144/86 mmHg
Cranial nerve exam showed dysarthria and midline tongue extension
limb strength was 5/5 with normal tone
Babinski and other reflexes were normal
Brain MRI and susceptibility-weighted imaging were unremarkable
MRA showed mild cerebral arteriosclerosis
